chunks: But if you do not bring him with you, then I shall have no grain for you, nor should you come back to me.
ai.seo_question: What condition did Prophet Joseph set for his brothers to receive grain?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Joseph (AS) sets a condition for his brothers to bring their youngest brother, Benjamin, as a test of their sincerity and to fulfill the divine plan. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of 'tadrij' (gradualism) in leadership, where authority is used to guide people toward spiritual and moral maturity. The verse underscores the balance between practical governance and divine wisdom in distributing sustenance.
